# Mikhail Karan

> Personal portfolio for Mikhail Karan, Head of Engineering and Lead Developer at Cyfrin and co-host of HTML All The Things.

The homepage is prerendered and also supports `Accept: text/markdown` content negotiation.

## Primary pages

- [Portfolio](https://mikek.me/): Work, side projects, leadership practice, stack, experience, and contact details.
- [All links](https://mikek.me/links): Podcast, social, code, writing, and contact links.
- [Traffic](https://mikek.me/analytics): Public analytics and the privacy-preserving collection methodology.

## Agent interfaces

- [MCP endpoint](https://mikek.me/mcp): Stateless Streamable HTTP MCP server exposing the portfolio as a resource.

Use the canonical `https://mikek.me` origin. The `www` host redirects there.
